prompt: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer because it most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement about when sea stars reached their highest average count. According to the graph, sea stars were observed at an average of approximately 18 individuals per plot during the 2016 survey year, which is the highest value shown for sea stars across all four survey years.

Choice D is incorrect because the graph shows that sea stars reached their highest average count in 2016, not 2019. According to the graph, sea stars were observed at an average of approximately 12 individuals per plot in 2019, which is lower than the 2016 value.
